meanings: in a word, in short

examples.sr: [Јѐдно̄м ре̑чју], све је било узалуд.
examples.en: In a word, it was all in vain.

note: Sums up what was said.

meanings: in other words, that is

examples.sr: Иде ми се у ресторан. [Дру̀гим ре́чима], гладан сам.
examples.en: I feel like going to a restaurant. In other words, I'm hungry.

note: Rephrases the previous sentence.

meanings: so, that means, so then

examples.sr: [Зна̑чи], било је јако напорно.
examples.en: So, it was really tiring.

note: A filler word in conversation that sums things up.

meanings: to close one's eyes
forms: literally: to fold the eyes shut

examples.sr: Само [скло̏пи о̏чи] и одмори се.
examples.en: Just close your eyes and rest.

note: In literary language also «to die»: «склопити очи заувек».

meanings: to take someone at their word

examples.sr: Веруј ми на [ре̑ч].
examples.en: Take my word for it.

meanings: to give one's word, to promise

examples.sr: Дао ми је [ре̑ч], али је није одржао.
examples.en: He gave me his word, but he didn't keep it.

meanings: in words only, only in talk

examples.sr: Он је добар само [на ре́чима].
examples.en: He's good only in words.

meanings: word for word

examples.sr: Поновила сам све [од ре̑чи до ре̑чи].
examples.en: I repeated everything word for word.

meanings: empty words

examples.sr: То су само [пра̏зне ре̑чи].
examples.en: Those are just empty words.

meanings: crossword

examples.sr: Тата решава [у̀крштене ре̑чи].
examples.en: Dad is doing a crossword.

meanings: in a hurry, quick and dirty

examples.sr: Спремила сам ручак [на бр̏зу ру̑ку].
examples.en: I made lunch in a hurry.

meanings: at hand, within reach

examples.sr: Увек имам телефон [при̏ ру̀ци].
examples.en: I always have my phone at hand.

meanings: to have one's hands full, to be swamped with work

examples.sr: Данас [ѝма̄м пу̀не ру̀ке по̀сла].
examples.en: I have my hands full today.

meanings: to go smoothly, to come easily

examples.sr: Језици ми [и̏ду од ру̀ке].
examples.en: Languages come easily to me.

note: Its counterpart: поћи за руком, to succeed. Often negated: «Не иде ми од руке».

meanings: to give up on something, to wash one's hands of

examples.sr: Хтела је да [ди̏гне ру̀ке од] свега.
examples.en: She wanted to give up on everything.

note: Дићи руку на некога means to raise a hand against someone, to hit them.

meanings: in one's own way, a bit eccentric

examples.sr: Он је мало [на сво̀ју ру̑ку].
examples.en: He's a bit eccentric in his own way.

meanings: to turn down, to brush off (a suitor)

examples.sr: Она му је [да̏ла ко̏рпу].
examples.en: She turned him down.

meanings: to give it one's all, to do one's best

examples.sr: [Да̑ј све̏ од се̏бе] и победи!
examples.en: Give it your all and win!

meanings: to not feel like (doing something)

examples.sr: [Не да ми се] данас излазити.
examples.en: I don't feel like going out today.

note: Without «ми», «не да се» + inf. means it can't be done: «Не да се замислити».

meanings: God forbid

examples.sr: [Не да̑ј бо̏же] да закасним.
examples.en: God forbid I should be late.

meanings: to step on the gas, to speed up

examples.sr: [Да̑ј га̑с], каснимо!
examples.en: Step on the gas, we're late!

meanings: safe and sound

examples.sr: Вратио се кући [здра̏в и пра̏в].
examples.en: He came back home safe and sound.

meanings: all day long, the whole day

examples.sr: Седи и чека [по це̏о да̑н].
examples.en: He sits and waits all day long.

meanings: one day (in the past or the future)

examples.sr: [Је̏дног да̀на] ћеш сазнати истину.
examples.en: One day you will learn the truth.

meanings: these days, in the next few days, the other day

examples.sr: Јавићу ти се [о̀вӣх да̀на].
examples.en: I'll get in touch with you one of these days.

note: Past, future or present: the context tells which.

meanings: the other day, a few days ago

examples.sr: Видела сам га [пре̏ не̏кӣ да̑н].
examples.en: I saw him the other day.

meanings: as sure as day, a given

examples.sr: То нам је [ка̏о до̏бар да̑н].
examples.en: For us that's a given.

meanings: to this day

examples.sr: То не знамо [до да̀на дана̀шњег].
examples.en: We still don't know that to this day.

meanings: to cry one's eyes out, to sob bitterly

examples.sr: Девојчица је [пла̏кала ка̏о љу̏та го̏дина].
examples.en: The little girl cried her eyes out.

note: Here година is archaic or dialect for «bad weather, storm»: tears pour like rain.

meanings: to set one's eye on, to have one's eye on

examples.sr: [Ба̏цио сам о̏ко на] један стан у центру.
examples.en: I've set my eye on an apartment in the center.

meanings: to look at with suspicion, to give a sidelong look

examples.sr: Комшија ме [гле̏да и̏спод о̀ка].
examples.en: The neighbor looks at me suspiciously.

meanings: with the naked eye

examples.sr: Ту звезду не видиш [го̀лим о̀ком].
examples.en: You can't see that star with the naked eye.

meanings: corn (on a foot)

examples.sr: Имам [ку̏рје о̏ко] на нози.
examples.en: I have a corn on my foot.

note: Nothing to do with sight: it is named for its look.

meanings: to keep one's fingers crossed, to wish someone luck

examples.sr: [Др̀жӣм ти па̀лчеве] за испит.
examples.en: I'm keeping my fingers crossed for you for the exam.

meanings: to give a lecture

examples.sr: Професор [др̏жи преда́ва̄ње] из географије.
examples.en: The professor is giving a geography lecture.

meanings: to teach a class, to give a lesson

examples.sr: Не [др̀жӣм] приватне [ча̏сове].
examples.en: I don't give private lessons.

meanings: to keep one's word

examples.sr: Он увек [др̏жи ре̑ч].
examples.en: He always keeps his word.

meanings: to hold someone to their word

examples.sr: [Др̀жӣм те за ре̑ч].
examples.en: I'm holding you to your word.

meanings: to have self-respect, to care about one's reputation

examples.sr: Ниједан човек који [др̏жи до се̏бе] то неће рећи.
examples.en: No self-respecting person would say that.

meanings: to make noise

examples.sr: Комшије [пра̀ве бу̏ку] целу ноћ.
examples.en: The neighbors are making noise all night.

meanings: to make a fool of someone

examples.sr: Не [пра̀ви од] мене [буда̀лу].
examples.en: Don't make a fool of me.

note: Прави од себе будалу: to make a fool of oneself.

meanings: to throw a party

examples.sr: Сутра [пра̀вимо жу̏рку] код мене.
examples.en: Tomorrow we're throwing a party at my place.

meanings: to make a mistake

examples.sr: [Пра̀виш] највећу [грешку] у животу.
examples.en: You're making the biggest mistake of your life.

key: phr:први се мачићи у воду бацају
meanings: the first attempt always goes badly
forms: literally: the first kittens are thrown into the water

examples.sr: Не брини, [пр̏ви се ма̀чићи у во̏ду ба̏цају].
examples.en: Don't worry, the first attempt always goes badly.

meanings: in the middle of nowhere

examples.sr: Живе негде, [где̏ је бо̑г ре̏као ћа̑о].
examples.en: They live somewhere in the middle of nowhere.

meanings: penniless, broke

examples.sr: Дошао је кући [го̑ ка̏о пѝшто̄љ].
examples.en: He came home penniless.

meanings: blue blood, noble birth

examples.sr: Тврди да има [пла̏ву кр̑в].
examples.en: He claims to have blue blood.

meanings: of flesh and blood

examples.sr: Ја сам човек [од кр̑ви и ме̑са].
examples.en: I'm a person of flesh and blood.

meanings: one's blood runs cold

examples.sr: Од те вести [ле̏ди ми се кр̑в у жѝлама].
examples.en: That news makes my blood run cold.

meanings: blood is thicker than water

examples.sr: Помогли су му, јер [кр̑в нѝје во̀да].
examples.en: They helped him, because blood is thicker than water.

meanings: at daggers drawn, to the death

examples.sr: Два клана су у рату [на кр̑в и но̑ж].
examples.en: The two clans are at war to the death.

meanings: at full steam, at full capacity

examples.sr: Фабрика ради [пу̀ном па̑ром].
examples.en: The factory is running at full capacity.

meanings: in full swing

examples.sr: Журка је била [у пу̀ном је̏ку].
examples.en: The party was in full swing.

meanings: rolling in money, loaded

examples.sr: Он је [пу̏н ка̏о бро̑д].
examples.en: He's rolling in money.

meanings: full moon

examples.sr: Вечерас је [пу̏н ме̏се̄ц].
examples.en: There's a full moon tonight.

meanings: to make ends meet

examples.sr: Једва [са̀стављамо кра̑ј с кра̏јем].
examples.en: We can barely make ends meet.

meanings: in the end, after all

examples.sr: [На кра̑ју кра̀јева], то није проблем.
examples.en: After all, that's not a problem.

meanings: at the end of the world, in the middle of nowhere

examples.sr: Ми живимо [на кра̑ју све̑та].
examples.en: We live at the end of the world.

meanings: to have a loose tongue, to be a blabbermouth

examples.sr: Он [и̏ма ду̑г јѐзик], не причај му ништа.
examples.en: He has a loose tongue, so don't tell him anything.

meanings: to find common ground, to get on

examples.sr: Ускоро смо [на̏шли за̀једнички јѐзик].
examples.en: We soon found common ground.

meanings: on the tip of one's tongue

examples.sr: [На вр̏х] ми је [језика], али не могу да се сетим.
examples.en: It's on the tip of my tongue, but I can't remember.

meanings: to bite one's tongue

examples.sr: [У̀гризи се за јѐзик] док не чујеш све.
examples.en: Bite your tongue until you've heard everything.

meanings: to pry words out of someone, to make someone talk

examples.sr: Нико га није [ву̀као за јѐзик].
examples.en: Nobody forced him to say it.

meanings: to you and yours

examples.sr: [Ва̏ма и ва̏шима] желим здраву и успешну годину.
examples.en: I wish you and yours a healthy and successful year.

note: «Вашима» here means your family and loved ones. A formula for colleagues and acquaintances.

key: phr:вук длаку мења, а ћуд никада
meanings: a leopard can't change its spots
forms: literally: the wolf changes its coat, but never its nature

examples.sr: Није се променио: [ву̑к дла̏ку ме̏ња, а ћу̑д ни̏када].
examples.en: He hasn't changed: a leopard can't change its spots.

key: phr:крсти вука, а вук у гору
meanings: you can't tame a wolf
a leopard can't change its spots
forms: literally: baptize the wolf, and the wolf heads for the mountain

examples.sr: Сто пута сам му рекао - [кр̑сти ву̑ка, а ву̑к у го̏ру].
examples.en: I've told him a hundred times, but baptize a wolf all you like, it still heads for the hills.

key: phr:и вук сит и овце на броју
meanings: to have it both ways, a win-win

examples.sr: Договор је такав да [и ву̑к си̑т и о̀вце на бро̑ју].
examples.en: The deal is such that everybody wins.

meanings: to set the fox to guard the henhouse
to put the wolf in charge of the sheep

examples.sr: Именовати га за чувара је као [по̀ставити ву́ка за пасти́ра].
examples.en: Appointing him as a guard is like setting the fox to guard the henhouse.

meanings: gone without a trace, nobody to blame
forms: literally: the wolf ate the donkey

examples.sr: Новац је нестао, [по̀јео ву̑к ма̀гарца].
examples.en: The money disappeared without a trace, and nobody is to blame.

meanings: a wolf in sheep's clothing

examples.sr: Изгледа фино, али је [ву̑к у ја̏гњећој ко̏жи].
examples.en: He looks nice, but he's a wolf in sheep's clothing.

meanings: this and that, and so on

examples.sr: Почели су да раде заједно, [о̀во̄ о̀но].
examples.en: They started working together, and so on and so forth.

meanings: I don't care, it's all the same to me

examples.sr: Сви ми се смеју, али [не ма̏рим].
examples.en: Everyone is laughing at me, but I don't care.

note: With an object: «не марим за» + acc.

meanings: between a rock and a hard place

examples.sr: Био је [и̏змеђу ва̏тре и во̀де] и није знао шта да ради.
examples.en: He was between a rock and a hard place and didn't know what to do.

meanings: a storm in a teacup, much ado about nothing

examples.sr: Цела свађа је била [бу̏ра у ча̏ши во̀де].
examples.en: The whole quarrel was a storm in a teacup.

meanings: plenty, in abundance, galore

examples.sr: У њега има посла [ка̏о во̀де].
examples.en: He has work coming out of his ears.

note: Pattern: «има» + gen. + «као воде»: Има пара као воде.

meanings: to leave in the lurch, to betray, to let go to waste
forms: literally: to let go down the water

examples.sr: Кад му више није требао, [пу̏стио га је ни̑з во̏ду].
examples.en: When he no longer needed him, he left him in the lurch.

meanings: a drop in the ocean

examples.sr: Та помоћ је [ка̏о ка̑п во̀де у мо̑ру].
examples.en: That help is a drop in the ocean.

key: phr:чувати као мало воде на длану
meanings: to treasure like the apple of one's eye, to handle with great care
forms: literally: to guard like a little water in the palm

examples.sr: Он чува ту девојку [ка̏о ма̏ло во̀де на дла̑ну].
examples.en: He treasures that girl like the apple of his eye.

meanings: to pull the wool over someone's eyes, to con skillfully
forms: literally: to lead a thirsty man across the water

examples.sr: Он уме да [прѐведе жѐдног прѐко во̀де].
examples.en: He knows how to pull the wool over people's eyes.

meanings: to grow like a weed
forms: literally: to grow as if out of water

examples.sr: Дете [ра̏сте ка̏о из во̀де].
examples.en: The child is growing like a weed.

meanings: a return ticket to..., a round-trip ticket to...

examples.sr: [По̀вратна ка̑рта до] Смедерева, молим вас.
examples.en: A round-trip ticket to Smederevo, please.

meanings: to conclude a contract, to sign a deal

examples.sr: Након дугих преговора [скло̏пили смо у̏гово̄р].
examples.en: After long negotiations, we signed the contract.

meanings: to sign an agreement

examples.sr: Компаније ће [потпи́сати спо̏разӯм] о сарадњи.
examples.en: The companies will sign a cooperation agreement.

meanings: to set goals

examples.sr: На почетку године важно је [по̀ставити] јасне [ци́љеве].
examples.en: At the start of the year, it's important to set clear goals.

meanings: to fulfill obligations

examples.sr: Сви тимови су [и̏спунили сво̀је о̀бавезе].
examples.en: All the teams have fulfilled their obligations.

meanings: to coordinate deadlines, to agree on timing

examples.sr: Морамо да [у̀складимо ро̀кове] са другим одељењима.
examples.en: We have to coordinate the deadlines with the other departments.

meanings: big-hearted, generous, kind

examples.sr: Он је човек [ве̏ликог ср̑ца].
examples.en: He's a big-hearted man.

note: Same pattern: каменог срца, hard-hearted; мека срца, soft-hearted. All in the genitive.

meanings: hard-hearted, cruel

examples.sr: Остао је [ка̀меног ср̑ца] и није хтео да помогне.
examples.en: He stayed hard-hearted and refused to help.

meanings: with a heavy heart

examples.sr: [Те̏шка ср̑ца] сам отишао.
examples.en: I left with a heavy heart.

meanings: with a light heart, without regret

examples.sr: [Ла̀ка ср̑ца] сам се одлучио на промену.
examples.en: I decided on the change with a light heart.

meanings: to take to heart

examples.sr: Све критике [у̀зима к ср̑цу].
examples.en: He takes all criticism to heart.

key: phr:пао ми је камен са срца
meanings: a weight was lifted off one's chest

examples.sr: Кад је стигла вест, [па̑о ми је ка̏ме̄н са ср̑ца].
examples.en: When the news came, it was a weight off my chest.

meanings: one's heart sinks into one's boots
forms: literally: the heart went down into the heels

examples.sr: Кад сам чуо звук, [ср̏це ми је си̏шло у пе̏те].
examples.en: When I heard the sound, my heart sank into my boots.

meanings: to break someone's heart

examples.sr: Његов одлазак јој је [сло̏мио ср̏це].
examples.en: His leaving broke her heart.

meanings: on an empty stomach

examples.sr: Не пиј кафу [на̏ште ср̑ца].
examples.en: Don't drink coffee on an empty stomach.

meanings: get lost, beat it (colloq.)

examples.sr: [Ѝди у пе̑ршун], не смарај ме!
examples.en: Get lost, stop bugging me!

note: A mild, jokey way to say «get lost», not rude.

meanings: sparkling water, carbonated mineral water

examples.sr: Желим чашу [ки̏селе во̀де].
examples.en: I'd like a glass of sparkling water.

meanings: one's mouth waters
forms: literally: the water goes to the mouth

examples.sr: [Во̀да ми и̏де на у̀ста] кад видим торту.
examples.en: My mouth waters when I see a cake.

meanings: still waters run deep
forms: literally: calm water wears away the bank

examples.sr: Пази на њега: [ти̏ха во̀да бре̑г ро̏ни].
examples.en: Watch out for him: still waters run deep.

meanings: there was, it came to (an event)

examples.sr: [До̀шло је до] сукоба.
examples.en: A conflict broke out.

meanings: to cost someone dearly, to come back to bite someone
forms: literally: to come to the head

examples.sr: Једног дана ће му то [до̑ћи гла̀ве].
examples.en: One day it will come back to bite him.

meanings: to come into its own, to show itself

examples.sr: Његов таленат је [до̀шао до изра̀жаја].
examples.en: His talent came into its own.

meanings: to come to the same thing, to amount to the same

examples.sr: Како год да урадиш, [до̀ђе ти на и̏сто].
examples.en: However you do it, it comes to the same thing.

meanings: your day will come, what goes around comes around
forms: literally: the cat will come to the little door

examples.sr: Само причај, [до̀ђе ма́ца на вра̀танца].
examples.en: Go on talking, but your day of reckoning will come.

note: The sense: things will even out, and whoever was cocky will come asking.

key: phr:не знати да ли је пошао или дошао
meanings: to not know whether one is coming or going
forms: literally: not to know whether he left or arrived

examples.sr: Од журбе [не зна̑ да ли је по̀шао и̏ли до̀шао].
examples.en: In his rush he doesn't know whether he's coming or going.

meanings: to bring a lawsuit, to sue

examples.sr: Хоће да [ди̏гне па̏рницу] против комшије.
examples.en: He wants to sue his neighbor.

meanings: to stir up a fuss, to cause a scandal

examples.sr: Његова изјава је [ди̏гла пра̀шину].
examples.en: His statement caused a stir.

meanings: to take one's own life

examples.sr: У очају је хтео да [ди̏гне ру̑ку на се̏бе].
examples.en: In despair he wanted to take his own life.

note: A grave euphemism. Without «на себе»: дићи руку на некога means to hit someone.

meanings: to rise from the ashes

examples.sr: Након рата град се [ди̏гао из пѐпела].
examples.en: After the war the city rose from the ashes.

meanings: to get someone back on their feet (cure)
to rouse, to stir up

examples.sr: Лекар га је за месец [ди̏гао на но̀ге].
examples.en: The doctor got him back on his feet within a month.

meanings: to square (a number)

examples.sr: Хајде да то [ди̏гнемо на ква̀дра̄т].
examples.en: Let's square it.

key: phr:ако чељад нису бесна, кућа није тесна
meanings: cramped but cozy
forms: literally: if the household isn't angry, the house isn't narrow

examples.sr: Нас шесторо у две собе, али [а̏ко че̏ља̄д ни́су бѐсна, ку̏ћа нѝје те̏сна].
examples.en: The six of us live in two rooms, but as long as we get along, there's room enough.

note: A proverb: where there is no ill will, there is room for everyone. Чељад is archaic for «household».

meanings: home sweet home, my own place, my own freedom
forms: literally: one's own little house, one's own little freedom

examples.sr: Стан је мали, али [сво̀ја ку̏ћица, сво̀ја слобо̀дица].
examples.en: The apartment is small, but it's my own place, my own freedom.

note: Said with joy about having a place of one's own, especially after buying one. Слободица is an affectionate «freedom».

meanings: to be one's own man, to be independent
forms: literally: to be one's own person

examples.sr: Сада имам плату, [сво̑ј сам чо̀век].
examples.en: Now I have a salary, I'm my own man.

note: Here свој means «belonging to oneself»: independent financially and in spirit.

meanings: to stick to one's guns, to stand one's ground

examples.sr: Сви су га убеђивали, али је [о̀стао при̏ сво̑ме].
examples.en: Everyone tried to convince him, but he stuck to his guns.

meanings: in due time, in its own time

examples.sr: Све ће доћи [у сво̀је вре́ме].
examples.en: Everything will come in due time.

meanings: master of one's own house

examples.sr: Овде сам [сво̑ј на сво̑ме] и никога се не бојим.
examples.en: Here I'm master of my own house and I'm not afraid of anyone.

note: Said of someone who has every right on their own ground. Usually proud or defiant.

meanings: polite request: «may I have ...?»

examples.sr: [Мо̀гу ли да ѝма̄м] једну куглу ваниле?
examples.en: Can I have one scoop of vanilla?

examples.sr: [Мо̏жемо ли да и̏мамо] рачун?
examples.en: Can we have the check?

note: A polite way to order at a cafe or shop.

key: phr:само ћу да вас замолим за
meanings: I'll just ask you for ...

examples.sr: [Са̏мо ћу да вас за̀молим за] салвету.
examples.en: I'll just ask you for a napkin.

note: A soft request for something small. «За» takes the accusative.

meanings: to serve one's time in prison
forms: literally: to lie out a prison term

examples.sr: Пустили су га пошто је [о̀длежао ро̀бију].
examples.en: They released him after he had served his time.

note: Serbian says people «lie» in prison: лежати у затвору. «Одлежати» is to lie until the term is over.

meanings: to not lift a finger
forms: literally: he didn't move a finger

examples.sr: Цео дан је био код куће и [ни пр̏стом нѝје мр̏днуо].
examples.en: He was home all day and didn't lift a finger.

meanings: to lay a finger on, to harm

examples.sr: Ако га [до̀такнеш пр̏стом], имаћеш посла са мном.
examples.en: If you lay a finger on him, you'll have to deal with me.

note: Often negated: «ни прстом га није дотакао», he never laid a finger on him. May mean to hit or to hurt.

meanings: to have a hand in, to meddle

examples.sr: Сумњам да је и он [у̀мешао пр̏сте] у ту ствар.
examples.en: I suspect he had a hand in that business too.

note: Usually of hidden or unwelcome meddling: «овде је ђаво умешао прсте», the devil had a hand in this.

meanings: penniless, stone broke

examples.sr: После пожара остао је [го̑ ка̏о пр̏ст].
examples.en: After the fire he was left penniless.

meanings: to count on one's fingers

examples.sr: Праве пријатеље можеш [и̏збројати на пр̏сте] једне руке.
examples.en: You can count your real friends on the fingers of one hand.

meanings: to know inside out, to know like the back of one's hand

examples.sr: Он [зна̑ у пр̏сте] целу граматику.
examples.en: He knows the whole grammar inside out.

meanings: to lose ground, to lose one's footing

examples.sr: Влада [гу̏би тло̏ под но̀гама] пред изборе.
examples.en: The government is losing ground before the elections.

note: Both literal (feeling you are falling) and figurative: support or confidence is slipping.

meanings: to lose count, to lose track

examples.sr: Радио сам толико да сам [и̏згубио ра̀чӯн] о времену.
examples.en: I worked so much that I lost track of time.

note: Usually «изгубити рачун о времену». Рачун here is a count, not a bank account.

meanings: to lose one's cool, to lose one's temper

examples.sr: Не [гу̏би жѝвце], све ће бити у реду.
examples.en: Don't lose your cool, everything will be fine.

meanings: to lose face, to be disgraced

examples.sr: Не жели да [и̏згуби о̀браз] пред комшијама.
examples.en: He doesn't want to lose face in front of the neighbors.

note: Образ is «cheek» and «face» in the sense of honor. Also: «имати образа», to have a conscience.

meanings: to lose sight of, to overlook

examples.sr: Не смемо [гу̀бити из ви̑да] главни циљ.
examples.en: We must not lose sight of the main goal.

meanings: up to one's ears, more than enough

examples.sr: Мени је посла [прѐко гла̀ве].
examples.en: I'm up to my ears in work.

note: Often «свега ми је преко главе»: I'm sick of all of it.

meanings: to bury one's head in the sand

examples.sr: [Гу́ра̄ње гла̀ве у пе́сак] није решење.
examples.en: Burying your head in the sand is not a solution.

meanings: to get on someone's nerves, to take advantage of someone
forms: literally: to climb onto someone's head

examples.sr: Доста више, [по̀пео ми се на гла̑ву] са тим питањима!
examples.en: Enough, he's driving me up the wall with those questions!

note: Said of someone who pesters or gets too cheeky.

meanings: to plot against someone, to be out to get someone
forms: literally: to work on someone's head

examples.sr: Неко ми [ра̏ди о гла̀ви].
examples.en: Someone is out to get me.

note: A non-obvious phrase: радити here means «to plot». «Ради му се о глави» means he is in serious danger.

meanings: to throw up one's hands, to clutch one's head

examples.sr: Инвеститори [хва̏тају се за гла̑ву].
examples.en: The investors are throwing up their hands.

key: phr:не боли ме глава за то
meanings: I don't care about that
forms: literally: my head doesn't hurt over that

examples.sr: Нека раде шта хоће, [ме̏не не бо̏ли гла̀ва за то̑].
examples.en: Let them do what they want, I don't care.

key: phr:ко нема у глави, има у ногама
meanings: if you don't use your head, you'll use your legs

examples.sr: Заборавио је кључеве, па се враћао два пута - [ко̏ не̏ма у гла̀ви, и̏ма у но̀гама].
examples.en: He forgot his keys and had to go back twice - if you don't use your head, you use your legs.

note: A proverb: whoever doesn't think ahead ends up running back and forth.

meanings: the right moment

examples.sr: Стигли смо [у пра̀во вре́ме].
examples.en: We arrived at just the right time.

note: Literally «the right time»: what the Greeks called kairos.

meanings: on time, in time

examples.sr: Стигла сам тачно [на вре́ме].
examples.en: I arrived exactly on time.

meanings: in the spirit of the times

examples.sr: Њихов стил је [у ду̀ху врѐмена].
examples.en: Their style is in the spirit of the times.

meanings: from time to time

examples.sr: Звао ме је [с врѐмена на вре́ме].
examples.en: He called me from time to time.

meanings: in time, over time

examples.sr: [С врѐменом] ћеш се навићи.
examples.en: You'll get used to it in time.

meanings: to kill time

examples.sr: Играли смо карте да [у̀бијемо вре́ме].
examples.en: We played cards to kill time.

meanings: to gain time, to buy time

examples.sr: Морамо нешто смислити да [до̀бијемо у врѐмену].
examples.en: We have to think of something to buy time.

meanings: to waste time

examples.sr: Не [гу̏би вре́ме] на ситнице.
examples.en: Don't waste time on trifles.

meanings: to stab someone in the back, to betray
forms: literally: to drive a knife into the back

examples.sr: Мислио сам да ми је пријатељ, а он ми је [за̏био но̑ж у ле̏ђа].
examples.en: I thought he was my friend, but he stabbed me in the back.

meanings: to talk behind someone's back

examples.sr: Не волим кад људи [го̀воре и̏за ле̏ђа].
examples.en: I don't like it when people talk behind my back.

meanings: to turn one's back on

examples.sr: Када је остао без новца, сви су му [о̀кренули ле̏ђа].
examples.en: When he ran out of money, everyone turned their back on him.

meanings: to watch someone's back, to have someone's back

examples.sr: Ти иди напред, ја ћу ти [чу́вати ле̏ђа].
examples.en: You go ahead, I'll watch your back.

meanings: to see the back of someone, to be glad to see someone go

examples.sr: Једва сам дочекао да му [ви̏дӣм ле̏ђа].
examples.en: I could hardly wait to see the back of him.

note: Ironic: you are glad an unpleasant person has finally left.

meanings: to have one foot in the grave

examples.sr: Старица је већ била [јѐдно̄м но̀го̄м у гро̑бу].
examples.en: The old woman already had one foot in the grave.

note: Variant: «на ивици гроба», on the edge of the grave.

meanings: to the grave, until death

examples.sr: Остао јој је веран [до гро̑ба].
examples.en: He remained faithful to her to the grave.

meanings: to take to the grave

examples.sr: Своје тајне ћу [о̀дне̄ти у гро̏б].
examples.en: I'll take my secrets to the grave.

note: Of a secret one will never tell. Compare «ћутати као гроб».

meanings: to be silent as the grave

examples.sr: Реци ми, ја ћу [ћу́тати ка̏о гро̏б].
examples.en: Tell me, and I'll be silent as the grave.

meanings: to turn over in one's grave

examples.sr: Јадни мој деда би се [прѐврнуо у гро̑бу].
examples.en: My poor grandfather would turn over in his grave.

note: Almost always in the conditional: the dead would be horrified at today's disgrace.

meanings: to drive someone to an early grave

examples.sr: [О̀тераћете ме у гро̏б] са тим бригама!
examples.en: You'll drive me to an early grave with those worries!

note: Literal or an exaggeration: to worry someone to death.

meanings: better the grave than slavery

examples.sr: „[Бо̏ље̄ у гро̏б не̏го ро̏б]“ - вичу они на тргу.
examples.en: "Better the grave than slavery," they shout in the square.

note: A well-known rhyming slogan: гроб - роб. Readiness to die rather than submit.

meanings: from the cradle to the grave

examples.sr: Држава брине о њима [од ко̀ле̄вке до гро̑ба].
examples.en: The state takes care of them from the cradle to the grave.

meanings: by (doing something), in such a way that

examples.sr: Деца уче језик [та̀ко̄ што̏] слушају родитеље.
examples.en: Children learn a language by listening to their parents.

examples.sr: Можеш помоћи [та̀ко̄ што̏ ћеш о̀стати] овде.
examples.en: You can help by staying here.

note: Followed by a full clause with its own verb in the right tense.

meanings: to come to one's senses
forms: literally: to call oneself to reason

examples.sr: Надам се да ће се [до̀звати па̀мети] пре него што буде касно.
examples.en: I hope he comes to his senses before it's too late.

meanings: to knock on many doors, to go from door to door

examples.sr: Морао је [оби́јати мно̏га вра́та] док није нашао посао.
examples.en: He had to knock on many doors before he found a job.

meanings: behind closed doors

examples.sr: Одлука је донета [и̏за за̀творених вра́та].
examples.en: The decision was made behind closed doors.

meanings: to find nobody home, to find the door shut

examples.sr: Стигао је касно и само је [по̀љубио вра́та].
examples.en: He arrived late and found only a closed door.

note: Said when someone arrives and nobody is home or the door is locked: all he got was the door.

meanings: through the back door

examples.sr: Лакше се улази [на ма̀ла вра́та] него на велика.
examples.en: It's easier to get in through the back door than through the front.

note: To get what you want outside the official procedure, through connections. The front door is «на велика врата».

meanings: to cast a glance, to glance

examples.sr: [Ба̏цио је по̏гле̄д] на сат и наставио да ради.
examples.en: He glanced at the clock and went on working.

meanings: to lower one's gaze

examples.sr: Када су га питали за грешку, [о̀борио је по̏гле̄д].
examples.en: When they asked him about the mistake, he lowered his gaze.

meanings: to fix one's gaze, to turn one's eyes

examples.sr: Сви су [у̀смерили по̏гле̄д] ка говорнику.
examples.en: Everyone turned their eyes to the speaker.

meanings: at first glance

examples.sr: [На пр̏ви по̏гле̄д] кућа је изгледала обично.
examples.en: At first glance the house looked ordinary.

meanings: in every respect

examples.sr: То је био [у сва̑ком по̀гледу] успешан састанак.
examples.en: It was a successful meeting in every respect.

note: Поглед means both «look» and «respect, aspect». Also «у том погледу», in that respect.

meanings: a room with a view

examples.sr: Резервисали смо [со̏бу са по̏гле̄дом] на море.
examples.en: We booked a room with a sea view.

note: Поглед also means «view, panorama»: поглед на море.

meanings: no man's land

examples.sr: Између граница простире се [ни̏чија̄ зѐмља].
examples.en: No man's land stretches between the borders.

meanings: the promised land

examples.sr: Многи су мислили да је Америка [о̀бећана зѐмља].
examples.en: Many thought America was the promised land.

meanings: to wipe off the face of the earth

examples.sr: Поплава је скоро [збри̏сала сѐло с ли̏ца зѐмље].
examples.en: The flood almost wiped the village off the face of the earth.

meanings: may the earth rest lightly on him, may he rest in peace

examples.sr: [Ла̀ка му цр̏на зѐмља], био је добар човек.
examples.en: May the earth rest lightly on him, he was a good man.

note: Said of the dead; literally «may the black earth be light on him».

meanings: to tie the knot, to get married
forms: literally: to step on the crazy stone

examples.sr: После десет година везе, коначно је [ста̏о на лу̑дӣ ка̏ме̄н].
examples.en: After ten years together, he finally tied the knot.

note: Jocular: marriage is likened to a crazy step.

key: phr:не оставити ни камен на камену
meanings: to leave not one stone upon another
to tear to shreds

examples.sr: Критичар [нѝје о̀ставио ни ка̏ме̄н на ка̀мену] од те представе.
examples.en: The critic tore that play to shreds.

meanings: neat and tidy, in perfect order

examples.sr: Све је уредно, све [под ко̀нац].
examples.en: Everything is tidy, everything is in perfect order.

meanings: to hang by a thread
forms: literally: to hang on a thread

examples.sr: Његов живот [ви̏си о ко̀нцу].
examples.en: His life is hanging by a thread.

meanings: to upset someone's plans, to throw a wrench in the works

examples.sr: Желели смо да [по̀мрсимо ко̀нце] фавориту.
examples.en: We wanted to throw a wrench in the favorite's plans.

key: phr:држати све конце у својим рукама
meanings: to hold all the strings, to keep everything under control

examples.sr: Он жели да [др̏жи све̏ ко̀нце у сво̀јӣм ру̀кама].
examples.en: He wants to hold all the strings in his hands.

note: The image of a puppeteer pulling the strings.

meanings: to rake in money

examples.sr: Чуо сам да они [мла̑те̄ па̏ре].
examples.en: I heard they're raking in the money.

note: Slightly ironic: of those who earn a lot, and easily.

meanings: to not be worth a red cent
forms: literally: to not be worth even a split para

examples.sr: Његово обећање [не вре̏ди ни прѐбијене па̏ре].
examples.en: His promise isn't worth a red cent.

note: Пребијена пара is a split coin worth nothing. Said of things and of deeds.

meanings: a fortune, a ridiculous amount of money

examples.sr: Дао је [гр̏дне па̏ре] за тај аутомобил.
examples.en: He paid a fortune for that car.

note: Грдан means «ugly, huge»; it stresses how big the sum is.

meanings: to be rolling in money

examples.sr: Она [ле̏жи на па̏рама], а стално се жали.
examples.en: She's rolling in money, yet she complains all the time.

meanings: good heavens, my goodness (surprise)

examples.sr: Шта је ово, [бо̑г те ви̑део]!
examples.en: What on earth is this, good heavens!

note: An exclamation of surprise or annoyance.

meanings: to beg in God's name, to implore

examples.sr: [Ку̏мим те бо̏гом], реци ми истину.
examples.en: I implore you, tell me the truth.

note: Usually in the form «Кумим те богом».

meanings: God forbid

examples.sr: Он ће да се предомисли? [Бо̏же са̀чувај]!
examples.en: He's going to change his mind? God forbid!

key: phr:бог је најпре себи створио браду
meanings: charity begins at home
forms: literally: God first made a beard for himself

examples.sr: Свако мисли на себе: [бо̑г је на̏јпре се̏би ство̏рио бра̑ду].
examples.en: Everyone thinks of themselves: charity begins at home.

key: phr:где је бог рекао лаку ноћ
meanings: in the middle of nowhere
forms: literally: where God said good night

examples.sr: Они живе [та̏мо где̏ је бо̑г ре̏као ла̀ку но̑ћ].
examples.en: They live in the middle of nowhere.

note: Synonyms: «богу иза леђа», «богу иза ногу». Said of a very remote, out-of-the-way place.

meanings: no relation at all, a complete stranger

examples.sr: Шта ме брига за тог човека, он ми је [ни ро̑д ни по̀моз бо̑г].
examples.en: Why should I care about that man, he's nothing to me.

note: Said of an outsider who is neither a relative nor a friend. Often written «ни род ни помоз' бог».

key: phr:ко није са мном, против мене је
meanings: whoever is not with me is against me

examples.sr: „[Ко̏ нѝје са мно̑м, про̏тив ме̏не је]“, рекао је вођа.
examples.en: "Whoever is not with me is against me," said the leader.

note: A biblical quotation.

key: phr:око за око, зуб за зуб
meanings: an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth

examples.sr: Освета по принципу „[о̏ко за о̏ко, зу̑б за зу̑б]“ не решава ништа.
examples.en: Revenge on the principle of "an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth" solves nothing.

meanings: blessed are the poor in spirit

examples.sr: „[Бла̀жени сиро̀машнӣ ду̀хом]“, каже Свето писмо.
examples.en: "Blessed are the poor in spirit," says the Scripture.

meanings: a voice crying in the wilderness

examples.sr: Његови позиви остали су [гла̑с ва̀пијућег у пу̀стињи].
examples.en: His appeals remained a voice crying in the wilderness.

note: «Вапијући» is a bookish participle, rare in modern speech.

meanings: the last shall be first

examples.sr: „[По̀следњӣ ће би̏ти пр̏ви], а први последњи“, каже изрека.
examples.en: "The last shall be first, and the first last," says the saying.

key: phr:не живи човек о самом хлебу
meanings: man shall not live by bread alone

examples.sr: Читање је важно: [не жи̏ви чо̀век о са̀мом хле̏бу].
examples.en: Reading is important: man shall not live by bread alone.

note: A biblical quotation.

meanings: starving, hungry as a wolf

examples.sr: Нисам јео од јутрос, [гла́дан сам ка̏о па̑с].
examples.en: I haven't eaten since this morning, I'm starving.

meanings: to fight like cats and dogs

examples.sr: Комшије [жи̏ве ка̏о па̑с и ма̏чка].
examples.en: The neighbors fight like cats and dogs.

meanings: his bark is worse than his bite

examples.sr: Не плаши га се, [па̑с ко̀јӣ ла̏је̄ не у̀једа].
examples.en: Don't be afraid of him, his bark is worse than his bite.
